findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe Deserialization
 * @description Detects unsafe deserialization using pickle.
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module DeserializationConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource or
    source instanceof DataFlow::ParameterNode
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module DeserializationFlow = TaintTracking::Global<DeserializationConfig>;
import DeserializationFlow::PathGraph

from DeserializationFlow::PathNode source, DeserializationFlow::PathNode sink
where DeserializationFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Potential unsafe deserialization from $@.", source.getNode(), "untrusted input"
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization of untrusted data via pickle.

message.text: Potential unsafe deserialization from [untrusted input](1).

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe Deserialization Context
 * @description Inspects the usage of pickle.load in cache.py
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization-context
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "cache.py" and
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Deserialization call found."
findings.hypothesis: Confirming location and context of deserialization.

message.text: Deserialization call found.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Weak Cryptography (MD5/SHA1)
 * @description Detects usage of weak hashing algorithms like MD5 and SHA1 which are considered insecure for collision resistance.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/weak-crypto-md5-sha1
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-327
 *       external/cwe/cwe-328
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember(["md5", "sha1"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("cryptography.hazmat.primitives.hashes").getMember(["MD5", "SHA1"]).getACall()
select call, "Usage of weak hashing algorithm (MD5/SHA1)."
findings.hypothesis: Usage of weak cryptographic hashing algorithms

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name XML External Entity (XXE) expansion
 * @description Parsing untrusted XML with a weak parser can lead to XXE attacks.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/xxe-injection
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-611
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("etree").getMember("ElementTree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring", "XML"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("etree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring", "XML"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("dom").getMember("minidom").getMember("parseString").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("sax").getMember("parseString").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potential XXE vulnerability via unsafe XML parsing."
findings.hypothesis: Detect usage of unsafe XML parsing libraries which might be vulnerable to XXE.
